title: Implement clean one-use CPTP rails and pay their workspace and completion tail
statement: Vacuum-plus-payload ports and bounded gate arity give local B_va=Jout A_va Jin^dagger and Phi=rho->sum B_va rho B_va^dagger+QrhoQ, which is CPTP. Legal states are circuit-DAG cuts carrying the ideal cut channel including arbitrary references; incomparable gates commute on disjoint supports and the ideal clock mixture is input-independent. With gate rate>=lambda, depth D, gate count G and predecessor degree b, completion probability >=1-delta by time(2/lambda)[D log(2(b+1))+log(G/delta)]. Fresh ports spend O(G) workspace and layout is paid. Forged/deleted tokens, recurrent ABA/stale recycling and fault-driven deadlocks are not repaired by this one-use theorem.
